member.name: T:AIGuiders.Platform.Execution.Language.Xml.Anchors.XmlBracketAnchorResolve
member.summary: Resolve X:/A: to a 1-based text range (MSBuild-ish XML, no namespaces). Segments: Name, Name@Attr=value, Name:2 (1-based among matching siblings). K:Element — if leaf missing, insert under parent (zero-width range + insert name).
